name: MITRE ATT&CK (Enterprise)
description: MITRE's knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques based on real-world observations, used here at the tactic level to assess whether an organization's controls address each stage of the attack lifecycle.
contentStatusNotice: Tactic identifiers and structure are drawn from the public MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Matrix (v19). Purpose, summary, and review guidance are application-authored to support compliance review workflows and are not official MITRE guidance.
